quests.instruction: What is the name for the tube-shaped part of a shirt that covers our arm? It is also the part we roll up when our arms get too warm!
quests.question: Sleeve
quests.hint: It is a part, not a whole piece of clothing!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Sleeve is the tube-shaped part of a top that covers your arm!
quests.funFact: A sleeve is the tube-shaped part of a shirt that covers your arm!

quests.instruction: What item do we wear that fits snugly over our whole body for surfing in cold ocean water, and also instead of a swimsuit, when the ocean water feels icy cold?
quests.question: Wetsuit
quests.hint: It covers your whole body snugly!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Wetsuit fits snugly over your whole body to keep you warm in cold water!
quests.funFact: A wetsuit traps a thin layer of water that your body warms up!

quests.instruction: What item do we wear that snaps together at the bottom, all in one comfy piece, and also instead of separate pajama pieces, for cozy one-piece sleeping?
quests.question: Onesie
quests.hint: It is all one piece, from top to bottom!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Onesie is one snug piece of clothing worn all in a single go!
quests.funFact: A onesie is one single piece of clothing from shoulders to toes!

quests.instruction: What is the name for the soft, floppy part attached at the back of a jacket's neck? It is also the part that flops down our back when we are not wearing it up!
quests.question: Hood
quests.hint: You will not find this sold on its own in a shop!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Hood is the part that pulls up over your head to keep rain off!
quests.funFact: A hood is a soft, floppy part that pulls up to keep rain off your head!

quests.instruction: What is the name for the folded part of a shirt that circles our neck? It is also the spot where a tie is knotted, just below our chin!
quests.question: Collar
quests.hint: It is a small part, not a whole piece of clothing!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Collar is the folded edge of a shirt that circles your neck!
quests.funFact: A collar is the folded part of a shirt that circles your neck!

quests.instruction: What item do we wear with a tall, snug collar that reaches all the way up our neck, and also on the coldest days, when even our neck needs covering?
quests.question: Turtleneck
quests.hint: Its collar reaches all the way up your neck!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Turtleneck has a tall collar that covers your neck for extra warmth!
quests.funFact: A turtleneck has a tall collar that covers your whole neck!

quests.instruction: What item do we wear that opens all the way down the front with buttons, and also over a T-shirt when the classroom feels a little chilly?
quests.question: Cardigan
quests.hint: It opens all the way down the front!
quests.explanation: Yes! Your Cardigan opens down the front with buttons, making it easy to put on!
quests.funFact: A cardigan opens all the way down the front, so it's easy to put on!

quests.instruction: What item do we wear that shows which team or school someone belongs to, and also so a whole soccer team looks matching during a game?
quests.question: Uniform
quests.hint: Here's a clue: Everyone on the same team or school wears the same one!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Uniform is worn by everyone on the same team or school, all matching!
quests.funFact: A uniform shows everyone which team or school you belong to!

quests.instruction: What clothing item do we wear when we run, jump, and play sports?
quests.question: Sneakers
quests.hint: Think about this: They have bouncy, cushioned soles.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Sneakers have bouncy soles that make running and jumping comfortable!
quests.funFact: Sneakers used to be called 'sneaks' because they were so quiet to walk in.

quests.instruction: What item do we wear under a dress or skirt sometimes for extra warmth, and also with two long legs that go all the way to our ankles?
quests.question: Pants
quests.hint: They cover both of your legs, all the way down!
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Your Pants cover both your legs to keep them warm and safe!
quests.funFact: Pants usually have two pockets, but some have four or more!

quests.instruction: What item do we wear that swishes gently when we walk, and also instead of pants, with a shirt on top?
quests.question: Skirt
quests.hint: It hangs down from your waist!
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Your Skirt hangs down from your waist and can swish as you walk!
quests.funFact: A skirt hangs down from the waist and can swish as you walk!

quests.instruction: What clothing item do we wear closest to our skin, under all our other clothes?
quests.question: Underwear
quests.hint: Think about this: You change into a fresh, clean pair every day.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Underwear is worn closest to your skin, under all your other clothes!
quests.funFact: Changing into clean underwear every day helps you stay fresh and healthy.

quests.instruction: What item do we wear that gives our fingers a cozy, warm hug?
quests.question: Gloves
quests.hint: Each finger gets its very own little space.
quests.explanation: Fantastic! Your Gloves keep every finger warm and toasty in cold weather!
quests.funFact: Some winter gloves even have special fingertips that work on phone screens.

quests.instruction: What item do we wear that buttons up the front, and also under a sweater or jacket to stay extra warm?
quests.question: Shirt
quests.hint: It covers your chest, tummy, and back!
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Your Shirt covers your chest and back to keep your top half comfy!
quests.funFact: Shirts have been worn by people for thousands of years!

quests.instruction: What item do we wear when it snows and the wind feels icy, and also with our coat on the coldest days of the year?
quests.question: Scarf
quests.hint: It wraps around your neck!
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Your Scarf wraps around your neck to keep it warm and cozy!
quests.funFact: Scarves keep our necks warm when it snows!

quests.instruction: Which clothing item do we wear with open straps that let our toes feel the breeze?
quests.question: Sandals
quests.hint: Here's a tip: They are perfect for a hot, sunny beach day.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Sandals have open straps that let your feet stay cool in the sun!
quests.funFact: Sandals are one of the oldest kinds of footwear people have worn.

quests.instruction: What item do we wear on a cool autumn day before winter arrives?
quests.question: Sweater
quests.hint: You pull this over your head.
quests.explanation: Fantastic! Your Sweater is soft and warm, perfect for chilly days indoors or out!
quests.funFact: Sweaters trap warm air close to your body, which is what keeps you toasty.

quests.instruction: What item do we wear to stay toasty warm on the coldest days of winter?
quests.question: Coat
quests.hint: You wear this over all your other clothes.
quests.explanation: Fantastic! Your Coat is thick and warm, worn over everything else in cold weather!
quests.funFact: A coat with a hood gives your head extra warmth without needing a hat.

quests.instruction: What item do we wear when we run and play outside in the heat?
quests.question: Shorts
quests.hint: They stop above your knees.
quests.explanation: Fantastic! Your Shorts keep your legs cool and free to move on hot days!
quests.funFact: Shorts come in so many lengths, from very short to almost knee-length.

quests.instruction: Which clothing item do we wear that a baseball player often wears during a game?
quests.question: Cap
quests.hint: Here's a tip: Some people flip these around backward for fun.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Cap has a curved front brim that shades your eyes from the sun!
quests.funFact: Some people like to wear their cap turned backward for fun.

quests.instruction: What item do we wear before we put our shoes on in the morning?
quests.question: Socks
quests.hint: You wear two, one for each foot.
quests.explanation: Fantastic! Your Socks keep your feet warm and make your shoes comfortable!
quests.funFact: Socks were one of the very first clothing items people ever knitted.

quests.instruction: What item do we wear that slides on and off in a single second, and also with just one strap that fits between our big toe and the next?
quests.question: Flip-Flops
quests.hint: Here's a clue: A single strap fits between just two toes!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Flip-Flops have one simple strap and slide on fast for easy beach days!
quests.funFact: Flip-flops get their name from the flip-flap sound they make when you walk!

quests.instruction: Which clothing item do we wear that has a cozy pocket in the front for our hands?
quests.question: Hoodie
quests.hint: Here's a tip: You can pull the hood up over your hair.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Hoodie has a warm hood attached that you can pull up over your head!
quests.funFact: Hoodies became popular because they keep your head warm without a hat.

quests.instruction: Which clothing item do we wear that keeps all four fingers together in one warm space?
quests.question: Mittens
quests.hint: Here's a tip: They are even warmer than regular gloves.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Mittens keep your fingers snuggled together, which makes them extra warm!
quests.funFact: Mittens are often warmer than gloves because your fingers share heat.

quests.instruction: What item do we wear before ballet class, snug from our waist to our toes, and also under a skirt or dress to keep our legs warm?
quests.question: Tights
quests.hint: Here's a clue: They cover your legs AND your feet, all in one!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Tights cover your legs and feet in one thin, stretchy piece for warmth!
quests.funFact: Tights cover your legs and your feet, all in one thin piece!

quests.instruction: What item do we wear right after we towel off, before we get fully dressed, and also over our pajamas to stay warm right after a bath?
quests.question: Bathrobe
quests.hint: Here's a clue: You wear this right after a warm bath!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Bathrobe is thick and fluffy, worn to stay warm right after a bath!
quests.funFact: A bathrobe is thick and fluffy, perfect for right after a warm bath!

quests.instruction: What item do we wear that is light and comfy for playing outside?
quests.question: T-Shirt
quests.hint: It simply pulls over your head, no buttons needed.
quests.explanation: Fantastic! Your T-Shirt has short sleeves and pulls over your head easily!
quests.funFact: A T-shirt is one of the comfiest things you can wear to play in.

quests.instruction: Which item do we wear made of thick, stretchy rubber that traps a thin layer of warmth?
quests.question: Wetsuit
quests.hint: It is made of thick, stretchy rubber.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Wetsuit fits snugly over your whole body to keep you warm in cold water!
quests.funFact: Surfers and divers wear wetsuits to stay warm in cold ocean water.

quests.instruction: Which item do we wear shaped like a favorite animal, with a soft hood and little ears?
quests.question: Onesie
quests.hint: It often snaps closed underneath.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Onesie is one snug piece of clothing worn all in a single go!
quests.funFact: Some onesies are shaped like a favorite animal, with ears and a tail.

quests.instruction: What do we call the part that can be short, long, or completely missing on a vest?
quests.question: Sleeve
quests.hint: It covers your arm, not your body.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Sleeve is the tube-shaped part of a top that covers your arm!
quests.funFact: You can roll a sleeve up when your arm starts to feel too warm.
